parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing (generate a URL by using the explicit viapiutils scheme)](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: UserMask
parameters.description:
The URL of the mask image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing (generate a URL by using the explicit viapiutils scheme)](~~155645~~).

>The mask image is an RGB 3-channel image, not an alpha channel transparent image.
